entries.029e96d7ea8449bd: Individual customers who use the format for lunch, takeout or izakaya
entries.0a8425e562a6308e: Individual customers who enjoy jingisukan and highballs
entries.151ecc2c18d9c8e1: It operates 3 stores: 'THE SKY RESORT BBQ SOGO OMIYA', 'Keiō Sukai Biagāden' and 'THE RIVERSIDE BBQ NISHIKASAI'. From this period, operation was switched to Ikka Leisure Service Co., Ltd., and the stores are recorded under the Leisure Business.
entries.291a6b33690711a2: This is a mass-market pub format offering jingisukan (grilled mutton) made with low-calorie, high-protein lamb and all-you-can-drink service with highball towers installed at every table. As of March 31, 2026, there were 15 stores.
entries.3f807f3a0d42c091: Individual customers who enjoy stall food
entries.5e94acf5f9c27672: This format offers yatai (street stall) food such as tekkanagyoza (iron-pan gyoza), Hakata kushiyaki and motsunabe, in a space that recreates the atmosphere of the yatai street stalls of Hakata and Nakasu. It also offers its own membership system, 'Yatai-ya Kaiin'. As of March 31, 2026, with 47 stores, this is the format with the most stores in the group.
entries.63b3d7d3638c19e8: This is an authentic Japanese pub format offering handmade Japanese dishes such as oden, sashimi and obanzai, along with sake from across Japan, at standing counter seats and small-group table seats. As of March 31, 2026, there were 10 stores.
entries.68f66f11cb651c21: Individual customers who use restaurants (mainly business people in their 30s to 50s, as well as families and couples, among others)
entries.6f5b9d03bed31600: Individual customers who enjoy Japanese food and sake in a short time
entries.7c0e3209c5f5e44f: With the concept of combining a 'neo mass-market pub' with a butcher shop on a Showa-era shopping street, this format has 3 faces: lunch, takeout and izakaya use. Operated by consolidated subsidiary Ego Co., Ltd., it had 5 stores as of March 31, 2026.
entries.7e3fb68b104b7934: Individual customers from a wide range of demographics who enjoy Korean food
entries.817af4fe056d6fa1: This bridal facility is located in front of Tokyo Tower and has a chapel with a view of Tokyo Tower and 4 reception venues, each with a different character. It serves wedding meals in Japanese cuisine and has the restaurant 'Terrace Dining TANGO' on the first floor.
entries.8df9f81e2cf506c6: Individual customers who use barbecue and beer garden venues
entries.96bc95bbcdce95c5: A pure holding company of a group that directly operates restaurants such as izakaya and also handles bridal facilities and leisure facilities.
entries.9ae38c0fbf642f0c: Individual customers, mainly business people in their 30s to 50s
entries.a9ddb42d51f22c63: Individual customers who use the restaurant
entries.b41a5e32f58076ac: Individual customers who enjoy accommodation and experiences
entries.b775a47ec5719bfc: Individual customers who use leisure facilities
entries.b91e1ec604eefed0: With the concept of 'Korean street food to be enjoyed with all five senses,' this format offers authentic Korean cuisine and drinks. It also offers takeout and delivery. As of March 31, 2026, there were 4 stores.
entries.caba07a6a9033275: This business operates barbecue and beer garden stores and an experiential botanical garden resort. It is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Ikka Leisure Service Co., Ltd., and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥466 million.
entries.d140df4280132ea5: This business operates directly operated outlets of izakaya and restaurants planned and developed by the company group. As of March 31, 2026, there were 87 directly operated stores, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,905 million. It features 'omotenashi' hospitality from staff, serving customers as if they were their own precious people (family members).
entries.d72f6aefc5fc5f4d: With the concept of 'a second home for our guests,' this format offers Japanese cuisine centered on robatayaki (hearth-side grilling). The store features a display of fresh fish and seasonal vegetables along with an open kitchen. As of March 31, 2026, there were 6 stores.
entries.e61ab6dc4e9a86cb: This is an experiential botanical garden where guests can stay overnight, renovated from the Ibaraki Prefectural Botanical Garden and the Ibaraki Prefectural Citizens' Forest, combining 'stay', 'heal', 'eat' and 'play'. It opened in Naka City, Ibaraki Prefecture, in November 2025.
entries.e8da5eac41649ec5: This business operates the bridal facility 'The Place of Tokyo' and conducts wedding ceremonies and other party planning and events. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,158 million.
